shortDescription: Manages global attributes of VXLAN and bridge domain on HUAWEI CloudEngine devices.

options.name: bridge_domain_id
options.description: Specifies a bridge domain ID. The value is an integer ranging from 1 to 16777215.

options.name: nvo3_acl_extend
options.description: Enabling or disabling the VXLAN ACL extension function.

options.name: nvo3_ecmp_hash
options.description: Load balancing of VXLAN packets through ECMP in optimized mode.

options.name: nvo3_eth_trunk_hash
options.description: Eth-Trunk from load balancing VXLAN packets in optimized mode.

options.name: nvo3_gw_enhanced
options.description: Configuring the Layer 3 VXLAN Gateway to Work in Non-loopback Mode.

options.name: nvo3_prevent_loops
options.description: Loop prevention of VXLAN traffic in non-enhanced mode. When the device works in non-enhanced mode, inter-card forwarding of VXLAN traffic may result in loops.

options.name: nvo3_service_extend
options.description: Enabling or disabling the VXLAN service extension function.

options.name: state
options.description: Determines whether the config should be present or not on the device.

options.name: tunnel_mode_vxlan
options.description: Set the tunnel mode to VXLAN when configuring the VXLAN feature.
